answer: Saffron Pulse Windows: each identity earns rights only through unpredictable, short-lived work windows announced at random. Agents must wander across many such windows over time to accumulate standing. A single identity's score decays unless it keeps attending, so an attacker running N sybils pays N times the sustained attention cost—real labor-hours per identity—with no shortcut, since window timing is unguessable and missing one resets accrued weight.
